versions.subject: OSCD Task 7 ART T1220
versions.detection:
selection1:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\wbem\WMIC.exe'
    ParentCommandLine:
      - '*/FORMAT*' # wmic process list /FORMAT /?
selection2:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
      - 'C:\Windows\Temp\msxsl.exe'
      - '*msxsl.exe*'
condition:
    selection1 or selection2
